question: How many athletes received the Arjuna Award, 2024, during the January 2025 ceremony?
solution:
The correct answer is __**34**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Arjuna Award** is one of the most prestigious awards given by the Government of India to recognize outstanding achievements in the field of sports.
 
• During the **January 2025 ceremony**, a total of **34 athletes** were conferred with the Arjuna Award for their exceptional contributions and performances in sports during the year **2024**.
 
• The list of awardees includes athletes from various disciplines such as **cricket, hockey, badminton, boxing, wrestling**, and more.
 
• This award serves to honor athletes who have consistently demonstrated **excellence and dedication** in their respective sports.
 
• Recipients of the Arjuna Award receive a **bronze statuette of Arjuna, a certificate, ceremonial dress, and a cash prize**.
